title: L-Mechrevo GCU payload variant catalog (read-only inventory; ASCII-only by design)
purpose: Reference for a future EXTERNAL GCU mount package: identity, size and version of every shipped GCU variant.
payloadForm: 7z archives (install-time TEMPORARY files; never installed into the app directory)
unpackTool: installer-src\files\GCU\7za.exe (7-Zip 26.04 x64 console; a dontcopy install-time temporary file, extracted to {tmp} and deleted after the unpack)

unpackContract.unpackedBy: Install-Gcu.ps1 (step [3/8]): 7za.exe x -o<tmp> -y <archive>; the unpacked service directory is then landed - after the Authenticode check in [4/8] - DIRECTLY as {app}\GCU\AiStoneService\...
unpackContract.landingPath: {app}\GCU\AiStoneService\... for EVERY variant, including 1020 and 30. There is NO {app}\GCU\payload\<Variant>\ level and no per-variant directory in the install tree: only the SELECTED archive is unpacked, and nothing of the payload template is kept.
unpackContract.temporaryStaging: the package ships the five *.7z plus 7za.exe with [Files] Flags: dontcopy; the setup extracts them into {tmp} in PrepareToInstall (ExtractGcuStagingTemporaries) and Install-Gcu.ps1 deletes the archive and 7za.exe once the unpack succeeded (Remove-GcuStagingTemporaries). After the install {app}\GCU holds only AiStoneService\, logo\Language\, README.txt, NOTICE.txt and the three .ps1 files.
unpackContract.normalisation: the 7z internal top folder is NOT always the variant key: 1020.7z holds '20', 30.7z holds '30'. It is asserted against the catalog during the unpack and is NOT reproduced on disk (the landing path is fixed).
unpackContract.serviceDirNote: 1020.7z and 30.7z ship UniwillService (legacy naming, MyControlCenter inside); 40/50/WJ.7z ship AiStoneService. ServiceDir here is the name INSIDE the archive; on disk every variant becomes AiStoneService - see Install-Gcu.ps1 Get-GcuServiceLeafName.
unpackContract.renameRationale: the vendor binary does not read its own directory name (service.ini is only '[serviceinit]\nprocess=True' and holds no path; the only hard-coded product path inside the archives is the vendor's own 'C:\Program Files\OEM\Control Center\AiStoneService\...' in MyControlCenter\Command\ControlCenter.bat), while a single constant landing name removes both the nested-copy failure mode (source and destination shape would otherwise be identical) and the need for every downstream path to know the variant.
unpackContract.order: backup user data (UserPofiles / UserFanTables) -> unpack to temp -> verify vendor signatures -> copy the verified tree over -> restore user data (the 7z defaults must NOT overwrite the user's curves). The copy happens only AFTER the signature check, so a corrupt archive aborts before it can overwrite a working payload.
unpackContract.removed: 40B is gone: the 40-series has exactly one payload (40.7z). Every '40B' reference in this catalog is documentation of its removal.
unpackContract.removedVendorScripts: the vendor's install.bat / uninstall.bat / 清理官方控制台.bat are no longer shipped: their content duplicates our own Install-Gcu.ps1 / Uninstall-Gcu.ps1 (and install.bat hard-codes %ProgramFiles%\L-Mechrevo\GCU, assuming the driver sits inside the GCU folder). README.txt and NOTICE.txt ARE kept and land in {app}\GCU.

variantTable.selects: RTX 40xx-class machines and -Variant 40 (40B retired: -Variant 40B is treated as 40); 2026-10-21: 40 archive temporarily not shipped, 50 payload used, GcuVariant stays 40
RTX 50xx-class machines, the iGPU-only/office safety floor, and -Variant 50
machine model contains LNL (Lunar Lake Wujie), and -Variant WJ

archiveExtraDirsNotLaidDown.note: 50.7z also carries a top-level 'logo' and 'UWACPIDriver' sibling next to its service directory. Neither is copied: the language files come from the package's own logo\Language entry ({app}\GCU\logo\Language) and the ACPI driver from shared\UWACPIDriver -> {app}\UWACPIDriver.
archiveExtraDirsNotLaidDown.measured: 50.7z logo\Language\{en-us,zh-cn}.json are byte-identical to installer-src\files\GCU\logo\Language\ (same=True); 50.7z's UWACPIDriver is byte-identical to the shipped shared\UWACPIDriver too (cat/inf/sys SHA256 all equal, DriverVer 10/28/2025, 10.48.11.331) as well as to payload-old\GCU\UWACPIDriver - so taking it would NOT downgrade. An earlier note claiming 08/27/2024 / 11.2.18.347 was WRONG; corrected 2026-10-14 by measurement. It is still not used: only 50.7z carries it, and shared\ is the one source that gives every variant the same driver.

order: 1) -Variant <1020|30|40|50|WJ> forces that payload and bypasses hardware detection (any other value, including 'Auto', falls through).
2) machine model contains LNL (Lunar Lake Wujie) (case-insensitive) -> WJ.
4) nothing resolves -> 50-series safety floor, with a log line (never a silent pick).
judgeRules.retired: 40B - removed 2026-10-14; the 40-series has exactly one payload.

logFormat: GcuVariantSelection | variant=<V> | archive=<file.7z> | note=<machine string, keyword hit, chosen variant, unpacked archive>

registryValues.GcuVariant: actual variant string written by Set-InstallMarker (1020 / 30 / 40 / 50 / WJ)
registryValues.GcuPayloadSha256: manifestMerged.sha256 of the variant that was laid down
registryValues.GcuServiceDir: the ON-DISK service directory name, which is AiStoneService for every variant since 2026-10-14 (the archive-internal name for 1020/30 is still UniwillService - see serviceDir above)
registryValues.familyRule: source\MechrevoLite.Hardware\GcuVariantFamily.cs: Resolve normalises the retired '40B' to '40' for behaviour only; payload identity stays exact

knownGaps: This catalog is data only and must NOT be added to [Files]; the [Files] entries are the five *.7z (dontcopy) plus 7za.exe (dontcopy) plus the spread-out shared\ entries.
The retired 40B-era manifest hashes recorded below are superseded by the 7z switch and are kept only so old installs can still be identified.
